title: HNI Nifty Bi-Weekly Structure
summary: Image-backed strategy blueprint for Nifty with a Monday 9:45 AM entry, defined target/stop loss, and weighted CE strike selection.

image.alt: HNI strategy sheet with setup table and strike selection diagram

rules: Prepare the structure before market open and validate margin availability before entry.
Enter the planned position around 09:45 AM on Monday for the 8 DTE bi-weekly cycle.
Use pre-defined capital allocation only; avoid adding discretionary legs after entry.
Track running PnL against deployed capital percentage, not absolute rupee emotion.
Exit at either target or stop loss without averaging into losing exposure.
riskNotes: Risk first: even defined structures can face gap risk and volatility expansion.
Do not increase lot size to recover losses after a stop-loss trigger.
Slippage near open and around events can materially affect realized outcomes.
If market conditions are abnormal (major macro event), skip execution.
disclaimer: Educational content only; this is not investment advice.
Options involve substantial risk and may lead to capital loss.
Backtest, paper-trade, and validate execution constraints before deploying capital.
